<function name="SprintDisable" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Disables the sprint on the player.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Stops and prevents player with ID 1 from sprinting</description>
	<code>Entity( 1 ):SprintDisable()</code>
</example>
